_doc: The Atlas Todo app manifest, compiled into the server (atlas-core) and bundled by the clients (packages/client-core); operators never load manifests from disk. `kinds` lists the entity kinds the app syncs: todo's kinds keep their original bare names on the wire, every later app namespaces its kinds as `<app>.<kind>`. `plaintext_fields` lists, per kind, the fields a client sends WITHOUT end-to-end encryption; every other field value is encrypted. Only values the server must read stay plaintext: fan-out and membership checks (project_id, task_id, assignee_id, actor_id) and attachment blob addressing (blob_sha, thumb_sha); wrapped_key and meta are already ciphertext. project_member rows are server-authored ("all"). The client encrypts by this table and the server asserts that every field value it reads is listed here. Bump `version` whenever the kinds or their plaintext fields change.
name: Atlas Todo
